column3: The Hebrew separately names their fathers’ house and their offspring; BSB combines these as families descended from Israel.
The Hebrew calls them sons; BSB calls them descendants.
The Hebrew calls them sons; BSB calls them descendants.
The Hebrew says the record was not found, using the passive; BSB says they could not find their records.
The Hebrew says until the priest stands for Urim and Thummim; BSB explicitly describes consulting them.
The Hebrew describes the whole assembly as one; BSB gives the total without this comparison.
The Hebrew wording in this verse gives two hundred singers; BSB gives two hundred forty-five.
The Hebrew says “all Israel”; BSB says “the rest of the Israelites.” The Hebrew says the seventh month arrived while Israel was in its towns; BSB describes settlement by that month.
